change.requirement_text:
# Requirement #2234: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true

Source: https://github.com/MessagePack-CSharp/MessagePack-CSharp/issues/2234

#### Bug description

The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.

requirement_points.text: When SuppressSourceGeneration is true, the analyzer is still active and runs as part of the compilation.
When SuppressSourceGeneration is true, the analyzer reports its diagnostics for user code that violates its rules.
The analyzer does not require any source-generated types or files to be present in the compilation in order to produce its diagnostics.
The analyzer does not throw an exception or fail to load when SuppressSourceGeneration is true.

plants.description: Inverts the duplicate-key guard so the analyzer only tries to add a member when the key is already present, causing Add to throw on duplicates and skipping new members.
Equivalent rewrite of the string-member guard using explicit comparison to false.
Removes an explanatory comment without changing behavior.
Equivalent rewrite of the integer-member guard using explicit comparison to false.
Removes the ContainsKey guard entirely, so duplicate integer keys cause an ArgumentException instead of being reported.
Makes the guard always true, so Add is called even when the key already exists, throwing on duplicate keys.
Stores the member under an off-by-one key, so later duplicate-key checks for the real key never fire.
Deletes the member-tracking block, disabling duplicate-key detection for integer-keyed members.
Leaves an empty guard body, so members are never recorded and duplicate-key diagnostics are not produced.
Replaces the guard with a constant false condition, so the add is never executed and duplicate-key detection is disabled.
